profile_text.body:
# NVIDIA

NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California. As of January 25, 2026, the company reported revenue of $215.938 billion. The company describes itself as building "agentic AI with multimodal foundation models" and operates across AI infrastructure, data science, and foundation model development.

The company offers NVIDIA Nemotron, a family of multimodal open AI models designed for long-running, self-evolving agents with reasoning capabilities for tasks including graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding. Nemotron models are available as optimized NVIDIA NIM microservices, which the company describes as offering "peak inference performance and flexible deployment options." The Nemotron family includes specialized models for speech recognition, text-to-speech, neural machine translation, retrieval-augmented generation, and safety applications. NVIDIA publishes model weights, training datasets, and training techniques under the NVIDIA Open Model License, which allows users to use, modify, distribute, and commercially deploy models without crediting NVIDIA.

NVIDIA NIM functions as the company's inference microservices platform for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. The company provides additional development tools including NVIDIA NeMo for custom agentic AI and NVIDIA Blueprints for accelerated development with customizable reference workflows. According to the held facts, NVIDIA faces 220 cases in California.
